claim: The API product path is POST /opportunities/{id}/products -> job PRODUCT_BUILD -> ProductFactory; there is no single generic pipeline entry point and runners are thin hardcoded compositions
ProductFactory.execute writes brief.json, evidence.json, chapters.json, cover.png, product.html, qa_report.json and then runs the real gates and reviewers
A real generated product exists at artifacts/products/PROD-op1/product.html (15709 bytes, 1030 words, 8 chapters, 7 reference items, 8 cite anchors)
That product's qa_report.json shows gates_are_real=true, failed=[], both reviewers clean, projected_pages=2.7 vs max_pages=35
The brief used for that product carries fixture evidence strings 'student survey', 'comment archive A', 'comment archive B'
The chapter outline is a hardcoded 8-item literal list not derived from the brief
Worksheets/callouts/checklists/science blocks are injected by position (if i == 0/3/4/5/6/7)
OpportunityResearcher writes mechanism, competition_summary and feasibility as empty strings with the comment 'not derivable from comments alone'
No code writes the opportunities.mechanism column; grep for mechanism= finds only prose checks
Shark ESSENTIAL criteria are problem_specificity, reader_definition, differentiation, demand_severity_evidence; a non-MET essential yields REVISE
differentiation is MET only when mechanism has >= 8 words, so with mechanism empty it is WEAK and the verdict is REVISE
ProductFactory.validate requires Shark verdict exactly PASS or raises SHARK_NOT_PASSED
OpportunityRedTeam marks differentiation 'none' and demand 'unvalidated' for every raw-research candidate so the red team always KILLS
Red team failure signals include differentiation in (none, identical, commodity) -> RED_TEAM_KILLED
The tests assert the killed verdict for real candidates
The synthetic audience archive is titled 'REAL-scale research dataset' but every comment is drawn from a hardcoded list by a seeded RNG
Comment text is chosen with rng.choice from a hardcoded NICHE_COMMENTS pool seeded by _stable_rng
run_full_product_v2 calls the synthetic archive under the banner 'RESEARCH: 100 creator archive'
A real research chain exists: run_book_research fetches public Reddit posts and comments via pullpush.io with provenance
curate_book_evidence applies a strict relevance contract (body >= 90 chars, real author, core term AND pain phrase)
Real research artifacts exist on disk with fetched_at 2026-10-11T16:21:35Z (raw ~3.7MB, curated ~1.7MB)
The researcher prefers problems_<niche>_threads.json over problems_<niche>.json
Money _threads.json clusters have distinct_commenters 1/0/1/0/0 while the keyword-search file has 12/12/9/8/6
The mid_month_fade cluster's evidence is an r/options trading comment, i.e. off-topic
post_url in the threads artifact is a malformed double URL (https://www.reddit.comhttps://www.reddit.com/...)
OpportunityGraph.evaluate hardcodes near-constant coefficients (0.35*10, 0.25*6, 0.20*7, 0.15*5, 0.15*8)
OpportunityGraph.evaluate is called only by runs/run_full_real_test.py, not by the API production path
CreatorScorer.score loops over weights doing nothing and returns quality_score*100; only referenced by tests
EvidenceStore is an in-memory dict never persisted and never used by the product path
The AUTHOR BEFORE WRITER preflight (ProductPreflight/TargetReader/ValueMechanism/FullLoop) is referenced only by tests, never built in the product path
DpfBridge.generate_product always raises DpfUnavailable 'DPF invocation not yet enabled - deferred by policy'
inject_citations numbers the reference list and links each chapter's first paragraph by idx % n_refs, so citations are positional not claim-level
Evidence is truncated to 6 items before authoring
Evidence refs are capped at 6 by the producer too
The evidence library is 7 hand-written entries with source/year/url
_science_for_brief returns a fact only when the topic contains a money keyword, so non-money products get no science block
check_diagnostic_integrity imports QUESTIONNAIRE/INTERVENTIONS from the screen-time diagnostic module and validates it for every product
The screen-time diagnostic domain model is hardcoded in ipf/authoring/diagnostic.py
Gates A-M are structural presence checks; Gate H passes on routing/measure/unlike language
Gate I passes on the word 'escalate'
check_chatgpt_substitution passes on the words worksheet/route/fails
GATE_CHECKS pins 12 lettered gates each to a distinct measure function; run_all_gates adds M plus 13 hard checks
run_reviewers runs two deterministic reviewers; no LLM reviewer exists
No fact-checking, URL resolution, readability, originality/plagiarism or cross-chapter coherence check exists in the gates
No PDF/EPUB/DOCX/MOBI export exists; export is HTML only
The LLM gateway is a raw urllib POST to <provider api>/chat/completions with temperature 0.2 and max_tokens 1200, timeout 90, 2 retries with 1.5s backoff
Provider api and api_key are scraped by regex from ~/.hermes/profiles/automate-man/config.yaml
Model resolution reads a top-level model: scalar or the provider block, fallback deepseek-v4-flash
ProblemClassifier defaults to the model gpt-5.6-luna when constructed without a model
No token or cost accounting exists on the product path; usage from the response is never read
Config defines TARGET_PRODUCT_PRODUCTION_COST, TARGET_DAILY_LLM_COST, HARD_DAILY_LLM_COST_LIMIT and PER_WORKFLOW_COST_LIMIT but the product path never reads them
On model failure the factory emits templated prose and reports authoring_mode DETERMINISTIC plus an authoring_note
last_error is set on final model failure and surfaced by write_chapter
WriterClient has no retry while ProblemClassifier._chat has two; the two transports duplicate each other
ipf/writing/** is imported by no module under ipf/products or ipf/authoring; only by runners and by ai_problem_classifier for active_model
Measured test count is 1436 via unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests')
test_product_factory asserts the real gate module is used and that a real run completes with real files
Tests replace only the model boundary via an injected StubWriter
The validation ladder only allows SYSTEM_VALIDATED and PRODUCT_INTERNALLY_VALIDATED to be factory-claimable
The adapter passes only tests_pass/gates_pass so it can only reach SYSTEM_VALIDATED
Product records are persisted through one writer that inserts or updates the products row
The products base table and additive product columns are defined in migrations
The opportunities base table lacks the brief columns; they are added additively by OPPORTUNITY_COLUMNS
Opportunity brief columns are added by migration 0003 and problem_statement by 0008
A NO_DATA demand_verdict string is truthy and so promotes demand_severity_evidence to MET
The producer writes demand_verdict as 'NO_DATA (<ExcType>)' when no curated demand observations exist
DemandValidator returns PROBLEM_REJECTED unless evidence_complete is true
Job-level recovery marks RUNNING jobs INTERRUPTED and retry re-enqueues; there is no stage-level checkpoint in execute
Product creation is idempotent per opportunity and reuses the existing product row
A second, hardcoded book body lives in production code: 13 chapters of 'Stop the Mid-Month Fade'
run_author_book consumes the hardcoded book_content.all_chapters
A second hardcoded domain model ('Answer It Cold') lives in ipf/products/study_recall.py and is consumed by build_study_product
The diagnostic engine that would generalise the diagnostic to any domain exists but is only used by study_recall and tests
CanvaAdapter.create_asset always returns status DEFERRED, so no real design asset is generated
PromotionTracker is an in-memory reel-promise counter referenced only by tests, not by the product path
PrototypeBuilder produces a 3-page prototype but is referenced only by runners and tests
The cover is a deterministic stdlib PNG gradient, not a designed asset
The editorial benchmark/calibration machinery has real train/dev/held_out splits and leakage checks but is offline only
The human-heldout calibration split is 70% calibration / 30% human_holdout
HumanWritingAuditor returns a 13-field vector and never a single score
The working tree was not clean during the audit and ipf/api/server.py changed line count mid-session (989->1001->1000)
